m0-context.title: Load context and verify handoff completeness
m0-context.imperative: Verify the handoff has: task, intent, allowed scope, specific exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions, return format. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: handoff verified complete: all 8 required fields present
postconditions.satisfied_by: Handoff verified complete: task, intent, allowed scope, specific exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions, return format all present

m1-contract.title: Candidate-trajectory contract dataclass
m1-contract.imperative: Create src/preprocessing/trajectory_grading/__init__.py and src/preprocessing/trajectory_grading/contract.py with the CandidateTrajectory dataclass/Protocol. Units: time in seconds, arc-length in metres. Include per-lap structure, s(t) samples (1D arrays), per-sample variance, accessors for arc-length at a given time and integrated-speed arc length. No imports from evo/latent_power/compound_prior.

preconditions.satisfied_by: Context loaded from m0-context, handoff complete

postconditions.statement: contract.py exists, imports cleanly, no forbidden imports

constraints: No imports from src/evo_predictor, src/latent_power, src/compound_prior
Units: seconds for time, metres for arc-length

m2-sector-anchor-tdd.title: Sector-anchor gate (TDD: red then green)
m2-sector-anchor-tdd.imperative: TDD: write the known-answer test first (L1 — synthetic candidate with KNOWN anchors, verify recovery), see it fail (red), then implement score_sector_anchor in src/preprocessing/trajectory_grading/sector_anchor.py. Default tol_s=0.050. Anchors are co-estimated free parameters with uncertainty, never hard-coded. Also write L3 degenerate tests.

postconditions.statement: L1 known-answer test passes: synthetic candidate with known anchors recovers them; L3 degenerate inputs raise with named fields

constraints: TDD: red test first, then implementation

m3-covariance-gate.title: Covariance-consistency gate
m3-covariance-gate.imperative: Implement score_covariance_consistency in src/preprocessing/trajectory_grading/covariance_gate.py. Compute reduced chi-square of residuals against reported covariance. Pass/fail within configurable band. Write L2 covariance-honesty tests: white-noise with matching covariance -> chi-square ~1 (passes); inflated/deflated -> departs (fails).

postconditions.statement: covariance honesty tests pass: chi-square ~1 for honest cov, fails for dishonest

constraints: Reduced chi-square as the honesty metric

m4-cross-residual.title: Cross-residual diagnostic (NOT a gate)
m4-cross-residual.imperative: Implement diagnose_cross_residual in src/preprocessing/trajectory_grading/cross_residual.py. Per-lap: fit free inter-stream time offset; compare integrated-speed vs position-derived arc length with lap-closure constraint. Return fitted offsets + arc-length residuals. NEVER returns pass/fail. Write L2 test: inject known offset, verify recovery.

postconditions.statement: L2 cross-residual test passes: known injected offset is recovered; no pass/fail in return value

constraints: NEVER a gate: no pass/fail in return type
Clock pathologies of the two streams are NOT assumed independent

m5-report-schema.title: JSON report schema + docs/report_schemas/ doc
m5-report-schema.imperative: Implement frozen dataclasses for the full grading report in src/preprocessing/trajectory_grading/report_schema.py. Include: session_id, per-lap/sector anchor-gate results, covariance-gate result, cross-residual diagnostic block, fitted anchors+uncertainty, tolerances used. Add to_dict() serializer. ALSO create docs/report_schemas/trajectory_grading_report.md documenting every field. Producer + doc move together (repo policy).

preconditions.satisfied_by: sector_anchor, covariance_gate, cross_residual all exist and tests pass

postconditions.statement: report schema imports cleanly; to_dict() produces valid JSON; docs/report_schemas/trajectory_grading_report.md exists

check.command: py -c "from src.preprocessing.trajectory_grading.report_schema import GradingReport; import json; print('ok')"

payload.cmd: py -c "from src.preprocessing.trajectory_grading.report_schema import GradingReport; import json; print('ok')"

m6-tests-green.title: Full test suite green
m6-tests-green.imperative: Run all tests in tests/unit/preprocessing/test_trajectory_grading.py. All must pass: L1/L2 known-answer (anchor recovery + offset recovery), L2 covariance honesty, L3 degenerate/limit. Paste the full green output.

m7-simplification-limits.title: Simplification limits pass on all touched paths
m7-simplification-limits.imperative: Run py -m src.utils.simplification_limits --paths src/preprocessing/trajectory_grading tests/unit/preprocessing/test_trajectory_grading.py. Fix any violations (file >999 lines, function >99 lines, CC>19). Then commit all changes on the branch.

postconditions.statement: simplification_limits PASS on all touched paths
